question: Can a distinct upright recovery task and a ramp-to-active-hold handoff complete the exposed entry failures while preserving partial/prone recovery and finite walking/stop?

no_kick_handoff.change: After native reference-ramp completion, transfer to the existing V50 zero-amplitude hold when the actual upright and full startup-geometry checks pass; four measured supports remain a walking-readiness condition inside the hold.
no_kick_handoff.development_risk: V50 may still refuse startup or fail to acquire/settle four supports. The new handoff is a controller transfer, never a ready or success claim.

upright_recovery.change: Add a separately named native task for a body that remains upright above the partial-fall entry domain after the full passive descent. Keep canonical prone and existing partial recovery unchanged.
upright_recovery.development_risk: Unchanged V20 actuation is unproven from the high crouched states. The distinct task requires absolute standing and clearance rather than the deep-partial task 0.1 m COM gain; it cannot relabel an old timeout.

finite_walking.change: Compose the separately validated upright completion into a new finite-task reader; preserve all original walking/cycle/stop/envelope thresholds.

alternatives.reason: Both exposed kicked traces stay above the partial domain; more waiting does not provide a measured recovery route and may deepen joint/clearance violations.
Would change an observed task and retain its deep-collapse 0.1 m COM-gain requirement from a substantially higher initial COM.

alternatives.option: Change only the no-kick handoff and launch another held-out campaign
alternatives.reason: Leaves both known upright kicked failures unaddressed.

alternatives.option: Replace the active V50 hold with V55 braking
alternatives.reason: The existing hold is V50 and can actively seek support. V55 braking would be an additional controller change without evidence that it addresses the missing support.

first_pair.coverage: Both exposed phase-246 failures: native ramp handoff into V50 hold and upright recovery into finite walking/stop.

additional_single_kick_diagnostics.coverage: Second exposed upright failure, with distinct joint/tilt/support history.
Existing partial recovery regression through the new native/adapter route.
Existing canonical-prone recovery and consecutive-prone-reader regression.

development_coverage.additional_cells_prerequisite: First pair is valid and positive; each additional diagnostic is freshly declared and gated.
development_coverage.adequacy_argument: Five fresh cells cover the changed no-kick path, both independently observed upright failure states, and mutually exclusive partial and prone branches. Single-kick diagnostics make no paired effect claim and reuse no baseline.
development_coverage.prefix_selection: Explicit immutable mapping under a new development profile; no modulo-based accidental phase mapping.

zero_world_requirements: Reconstruct and bind all three original negative reports, original entry gates, and actual V50 hold identity.

Test native upright admission, consecutive/reset counters, original-timeout retention, branch priority, wrong task/memory/clock/energy/source/DLL refusal, joint repair versus strict final standing, and bounded timeouts.
Test no-kick ramp/hold handoff at the actual native interface and retained states, including missing supports, incomplete references, infeasible geometry, and no premature walking.

Exercise unchanged V55 walking/stop and V50 hold on the actual DLL across all 360 synthetic startup phases and representative exposed entry states; enumerate refusals without constructing physics worlds.

Run the complete applicable development safety gate covering launcher/ownership, native construction, bounded stepping, capture, finalize, replay, publication, and negative controls before each fresh diagnostic world.
next_execution_order: Build distinct native task and adapter/reader components under R10Q identities.
Run complete affected-path zero-world tests and retained-state interface sweeps.
Run the phase-246 fresh development pair, retain and independently audit both roles.
Only after that pair is positive, run the declared additional branch diagnostics with fresh identities.
Only after adequate development coverage, declare a new held-out population and finite contract; create a complete dependency manifest, fresh qualification and single-use authority.
